exposure: surgical technique for hysterectomy (abdominal, laparoscopic, robot-assisted, vaginal)
outcome: surgical outcomes (postoperative complications, intraoperative complications, bleeding >500 mL, conversions, reoperations)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 17,804 patients undergoing benign hysterectomies in Sweden between 2014 and 2023, with specific inclusion criteria for non-prolapse, non-endometriosis, and uterus weight less than 300g.
finding: The study found a decline in vaginal hysterectomies in Sweden 2014-2023, despite it being the cheapest method with few postoperative complications and short hospitalization compared to other approaches in low-risk patients.
